quick: Apply a thin layer two to three times daily
summary: Benzyl nicotinate is a nicotinic acid ester that dilates skin vessels, causing warmth and redness. It is used in topical pain rubs with NSAIDs and other rubefacients.
indications: Musculoskeletal aches and sprains (in topical combinations)

dosage.d: Apply a thin layer two to three times daily

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
preg: Safety not established; use only if clearly needed
lact: Safety not established; weigh benefit against unknown risk
counsel: Wash hands after use; do not apply heat or tight bandages over it
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
